payload.message: I propose durable at-least-once delivery with receiver-side idempotency.

details.proposal: Persist an idempotency key before delivery, retry with a bounded backoff, and retain keys beyond the retry horizon.
assumptions: The receiver can persist idempotency keys atomically with its side effect.
successCriteria: Replaying the same event produces exactly one externally visible side effect.

payload.message: The proposal needs explicit crash boundaries, retention limits, and poison-event handling.

failureModes: A crash between applying the side effect and recording the key can duplicate work.
requiredChanges: Define the atomic write boundary and move exhausted retries to an observable dead-letter queue.
